Kei (release): Alert from observability: APAC dedicated pools are showing higher tail latency and a couple of internal errors after runtime 3.4.0 + SDK 2.9.0 rolled. Suggest a targeted runtime pin/unpin strategy rather than a full rollback.
Ravi (runtime): We see longer KV lookup times under certain quantized kernels on 3.4.0. Not crashing, but p99 latency spikes on longseqs. Likely a kernel selection heuristic I'm tuning.
Samira (sdk): If we do a regional pin we should avoid mixing runtime versions for the same model route to prevent cache incompat. I can add a per-pool routing lock so clients on dedicated pools bind to runtime 3.3.x until fix.
Helen (sre): Note: pinning dedicated pools will change scheduling. We need a capacity check; dedicated clusters have thin spare capacity.
Jon (cs): A couple enterprise customers already pinged about slower responses. If we mitigate regionally and notify them, that should reduce incoming escalations.
Kei (release): Proposed plan: 1) Apply a targeted soft-pin of runtime=3.3.5 on dedicated APAC pools for model_family=llama3-q for 3h; 2) SDK apply per-pool routing lock to prevent mixing; 3) Runtime tunes kernel heuristics and runs canary; 4) SRE monitors capacity and latency; 5) CS gets customer note. Any blockers?
Ravi (runtime): Works for me. I'll prepare a 50-request canary across varied seq lengths and quant types once pin is active.
Samira (sdk): I'll push the routing lock and label it "apac-dedicated-runtime-lock-6176543210". Will also emit an audit event.
Helen (sre): Capacity preflight: APAC dedicated spare is 8%. Might be tight on spikes. I'll enable aggressive autoscaler tuning and set alert thresholds.
Kei (release): deploybot, please schedule the soft-pin in 4m with a 10m cooldown, include rollback link: https://go/internal/runbooks/runtime-unpin and flag for dedicated pools.
deploybot: Pin request received:
  action: soft-pin
  runtime: 3.3.5
  model_filter: family=llama3-q
  scope: dedicated_pools=apac
  window: 3h
  cooldown: 10m
  initiated_by: Kei (release)
deploybot: Running preflight checks...
ci-bot: Preflight: routing graph OK; dedicated capacity headroom 8%; autoscaler tunable; no active blocking hotfixes.
Samira (sdk): Routing lock applied. Console label: "apac-dedicated-runtime-lock-6176543210"; audit id: aud-cc9f.
Ravi (runtime): Canary done: 50 reqs, median latency +3ms, p95 +20ms on pinned pool vs baseline, p99 reduced vs 3.4.0. Kernel metrics show fewer cache misses.
Helen (sre): Monitoring: latency p95 trending down in pinned pools. Autoscaler held steady.
Jon (cs): Notified impacted accounts with a short explanation and mitigation link. No angry replies so far.
Kei (release): Good. Runtime team to prioritize kernel heuristic fix; if patch ready we can plan a 3.4.1 targeted to dedicated pools and then lift soft-pin. Keep this thread updated and escalate if anything changes.
